overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SET ROOT FOLDER command is used to modify the default root folder where 4D looks for the HTML files requested of the Web server.

constraints: The Web server must be restarted for a new root folder to take effect.
rootFolder can be given in HTML/URL syntax (slash-separated, platform-independent) or system syntax (absolute platform-specific pathname).
An invalid pathname raises an OS file-manager error, interceptable via ON ERR CALL; if the handler displays an alert/message, it appears on the browser side.
This setting overrides (is independent of) any default root folder configured in the Database Settings.
